See photos "T1 East" and “T1 Driveway”. • The canopy significantly overhangs the parking area. • The overhang interferes with the normal use of the parking space. • A modest reduction or crown lift as described above would alleviate the problem without materially harming the tree's appearance or health and restore the natural profile shape of the Oak.
